techParks.name: Bagmane Constellation Business Park
techParks.description: Bagmane's 30-acre, 5.3 msf park on the Outer Ring Road at Doddanekundi with eight towers (Phoenix, Virgo, Carina, Orion, Taurus 1-3, Aquila); Samsung's SRI-B occupies Phoenix, Arm's India HQ is Taurus 4 North Tower, Qualcomm leased floors of Virgo in 2025 and Nvidia shares Orion with Boeing - the densest semiconductor cluster in the city.

techParks.name: Bagmane Capital
techParks.description: Bagmane's 42-acre, 10.5 msf (5.5 msf complete) campus north of Doddanekundi Circle with towers Luxor, Kyoto, Rome, Angkor, Apollo, Troy and Memphis; Synopsys moved into Troy in 2024, Qualcomm took 6 lakh sq ft of Angkor, Samsung's SSIR opened in Angkor West in 2024 and Nvidia pre-let 760,000 sq ft of Memphis South from April 2026.

techParks.name: Bagmane Tech Park
aliases: Bagmane Tech Park CV Raman Nagar
techParks.description: Bagmane's original 42-acre, 4.7 msf park beside the LRDE lake in C.V. Raman Nagar (blocks Lakeview, Laurel, Olympia, Tridib, Quay, Crown, Commerz, Parin); home to Texas Instruments India's head office, Infineon, Lam Research, Dell's hardware R&D and Motorola Solutions.

techParks.name: Bagmane World Technology Center
techParks.description: Bagmane's 28-acre, 4.5 msf SEZ at Mahadevapura with gem-named blocks (Aquamarine, Citrine, Peridot, Amber, Moonstone, Coral, Goldstone, Opal); Ericsson's R&D sits in Citrine and Aquamarine, Arm in Citrine, Samsung and Nvidia in Goldstone, Dell EMC in Moonstone and SiFive in Amber.

techParks.name: Bagmane Cosmos
techParks.description: Bagmane's newer 3.5 msf park east of Bagmane Tech Park in C.V. Raman Nagar with three blocks - Ariel (Texas Instruments, 550,000 sq ft), Vesta (Lam Research and Palo Alto Networks) and Ceres.

techParks.name: Bagmane Solarium City
techParks.description: Bagmane's 82-acre campus at the ORR-Whitefield cusp (3.8 msf built of a planned 10.5 msf; blocks Neon, Xenon, Argon, Helium, Radon); Zebra Technologies' R&D centre is here.

techParks.name: Manyata Tech Park
techParks.description: Embassy REIT's flagship ~300-acre business park on the Hebbal-Nagavara Outer Ring Road; within this lens it hosts Nokia's 511,000 sq ft R&D campus, Nvidia's original Bengaluru design centre, NXP's Mfar Green Heart office and GlobalFoundries' Balsa block.

techParks.name: Embassy TechVillage
techParks.description: Embassy REIT's 84-acre SEZ campus on the Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli; Cisco's BANGALORE 26 SEZ office and Seagate's Building 2A R&D centre are the storage/networking tenants.

techParks.name: Cessna Business Park
techParks.description: Prestige's SEZ campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli ORR at Kadubeesanahalli, best known as Cisco's Globalisation Centre East (BANGALORE 11/15); Micron's Bengaluru engineering centre is also here.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecospace
techParks.description: RMZ's older Bellandur campus of numbered 'Campus' blocks on the Outer Ring Road, adjacent to Intel's SRR campus; Broadcom (ex-VMware) holds Campus 1A & 1C and Extreme Networks lists Campus 3B.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecoworld
techParks.description: RMZ's large multi-campus SEZ/non-SEZ park across the Outer Ring Road from Ecospace; Cadence's Bengaluru R&D is in Campus 4A & 4B and MediaTek opened its India R&D and sales office here in 2017.

techParks.name: RMZ Infinity
techParks.description: RMZ's Old Madras Road park near Byappanahalli with Towers A-D; Calix's India Development Center is in Tower B and Analog Devices ran its second Bengaluru development centre here before its 2018 HQ opened nearby.

techParks.name: RMZ Millenia
techParks.description: RMZ's towered office complex on Murphy Road, Ulsoor; Keysight's India office is in Tower D and Micron lists a Tower B unit.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Park
techParks.description: Prestige's campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli ORR at Kadubeesanahalli (Sy No. 143/1 Amani Bellandur Khane); home to the SanDisk India Device Design Centre and Western Digital's engineering office.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Platina
techParks.description: Prestige's office complex beside Prestige Tech Park on the ORR; MosChip's Bengaluru design centre is in its 24/7 Building (The Hive).

techParks.name: Prestige Technostar
techParks.locality: Doddanekundi Industrial Area 2 / Brookefield (ITPL Main Road)
techParks.description: Prestige's ~1 msf campus off ITPL Main Road at Doddanekundi, taken almost entirely by AMD as its 500,000 sq ft 'Technostar' design centre opened in November 2023, AMD's largest anywhere.

techParks.name: Global Technology Park
techParks.description: Mapletree-owned multi-tower park on the ORR between Ecospace and Intel; Arista Networks' India R&D is in Tower A and Marvell's design centre in Tower D.

techParks.name: IBC Knowledge Park
techParks.description: IBC's tower complex at 4/1 Bannerghatta Road; Rambus' India design centre occupies the 12th floor of Towers C & D.

techParks.name: EPIP Zone Whitefield
techParks.description: KIADB's export-promotion industrial estate between Kundalahalli and ITPL; the plot-numbered campuses of Qualcomm (Plot 24, Block 1), AMD (Plot 102-103) and Microchip (Plot 149-B) make it the oldest chip-design cluster in Whitefield.

techParks.name: International Tech Park Bangalore
techParks.description: CapitaLand's pioneering Whitefield tech park (1998); Applied Materials' India engineering centre is placed here by OSM.

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 1
techParks.description: The original 1978 electronics industrial estate west of Hosur Road; Tejas Networks' headquarters (JP Software Park) and a Broadcom chip-design site are here.

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 2
techParks.locality: Electronic City east of Hosur Road / Veerasandra
techParks.description: KIADB's eastern extension of Electronics City; Tessolve's semiconductor test and engineering headquarters is on Jogger's Lane in the Veerasandra estate.

techParks.name: Brigade Tech Gardens
techParks.description: Brigade's SEZ campus at Brookefield; Tenstorrent's India office is Block B1.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Softzone
techParks.description: Sattva's 1 msf park on the Sarjapur ORR at Bellandur; OSM places NI's (National Instruments) Bengaluru office here.

techParks.name: L&T Tech Park
techParks.description: L&T Realty's office park on Bellary Road next to Raintree Boulevard; L&T Semiconductor Technologies is headquartered in its S2 Building.

techParks.name: Kalyani Magnum
techParks.description: Kalyani's JP Nagar tech park; the VMware India software centre, now part of Broadcom, is mapped here.

techParks.name: Embassy GolfLinks Business Park
techParks.description: Embassy's 3.4 msf park off the Intermediate Ring Road; Dell's India corporate office is the Crystal Downs building.

techParks.name: Embassy Tech Square
techParks.description: Embassy's block-lettered campus (Alpha, Delta, Omega...) beside Cessna Business Park on the ORR; Ribbon Communications' engineering centre is in Alpha and Delta.

techParks.name: Pritech Park SEZ
techParks.description: SEZ park on the Sarjapur ORR at Bellandur; Cisco Video Technology India (ex-NDS) is mapped in Blocks 9A & 9B.

techParks.name: Intel SRR Campus
techParks.description: Intel's own 44-acre campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road with four design buildings (SRR1-SRR4); SRR4 (2018) added 620,000 sq ft including 100,000 sq ft of labs, making this Intel's largest design site outside the US.

techParks.name: NetApp Bangalore Campus
techParks.description: NetApp's own 15-acre campus at Hoodi on ITPL Main Road, opened 2017 as its Global Center of Excellence with capacity for about 3,300 people.

techParks.name: Huawei India R&D Campus
techParks.description: Huawei's own R&D campus in Whitefield, the successor to the telecom-software R&D centre it opened in Bengaluru in 1999.

companies.name: Intel
companies.description: US chipmaker; its Bengaluru site on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road is Intel's largest design and engineering centre outside the United States, with four SRR buildings on a 44-acre campus.

offices.label: SRR campus (SRR1-SRR4), Outer Ring Road
offices.address: Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road, Devarabeesanahalli, Bellandur Post, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: EQ Mag (16 Nov 2018) reports Intel inaugurating SRR4, a 620,000 sq ft design house with 100,000 sq ft of labs built for about Rs 1,100 crore on 'Intel's 44-acre campus on Sarjapur Ring Road (SRR) in Bengaluru' (https://www.eqmagpro.com/intel-india-inaugurates-new-design-facility-in-bengaluru/); OSM maps the campus as the commercial polygon 'Intel' (way/232892803) beside RMZ Ecospace, with three 'Intel' office POIs on its Ecospace-side frontage (node/4446516267, node/9851011197, node/9851011198).

offices.label: ITPL Main Road office (OSM-only, possibly historical)
offices.address: ITPL Main Road, Bengaluru 560037
offices.evidence: OSM office POI 'Intel Technology India Pvt Ltd, I T P L Main Road, 560037' (node/3496894402) is the only source; not on any Intel page reached, so it may be a former site.

companies.name: Qualcomm
companies.description: US wireless and mobile-SoC company; Bengaluru is one of its largest design centres, spread across its long-standing EPIP Whitefield campus and two Bagmane parks on the Outer Ring Road.

offices.label: EPIP Whitefield design centre (Plot 24, Block 1)
offices.address: Plot 24, Block 1, EPIP Zone, Whitefield, Bengaluru 560066
offices.evidence: OSM records five 'Qualcomm' office POIs around 'EPIP Zone, Brookefield, 24 - Blk 1, 560066' (node/3743283303, node/9851123907, node/9851123909, node/9851123910, node/11108008390) - Qualcomm's long-standing Bengaluru design centre; no Qualcomm page could be fetched (404).

offices.label: Bagmane Capital - Angkor East
offices.address: Angkor East, Bagmane Capital, Outer Ring Road, Doddanekundi, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: Propnewstime (Oct 2023) reports Qualcomm leasing over 600,000 sq ft (ground plus 12 floors, 108 months) at 'Bagmane Capital-Angkor' (https://propnewstime.com/latestnewsstories/MzU0OA==/qualcomm-expands-bengaluru-operations-with-600-000-sq-ft-office-lease); Bagmane's Capital page names Qualcomm among occupiers (https://www.bagmanegroup.com/portfolio/bagmane-capital); OSM POI 'Qualcomm' node/11472015243 sits on Angkor East.

offices.evidence: The Realty Today (3 Nov 2025) reports Qualcomm India Pvt Ltd leasing 2.56 lakh sq ft on the 5th, 6th, 7th and 11th floors of Virgo Tower, Bagmane Constellation, for five years at Rs 184 cr (https://therealtytoday.com/news/commercial/semiconductor-giant-qualcomm-leases-256-lakh-sq-ft-at-bagmane-constellation-for-184-cr/); Bagmane lists Qualcomm as a Constellation occupier (https://www.bagmanegroup.com/portfolio/bagmane-constellation-business-park); OSM POI node/13272544813.

offices.label: Bagmane Constellation - Carina West (OSM-only)
offices.address: Carina West, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, Doddanekundi, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: A second OSM 'Qualcomm' POI (node/6201853705) sits on the Carina West Tower footprint; single source.

companies.name: Nvidia
companies.description: GPU and AI-computing company; its Bengaluru design centre (opened 2005) sits in Manyata and is growing across three Bagmane parks, including a 760,000 sq ft Memphis South pre-lease that more than doubles its India footprint.

offices.label: Manyata Tech Park (Jacaranda / Silver Oak block)
offices.address: C-1 Jacaranda, Wing-A, Manyata Embassy Business Park, Outer Ring Road, Nagavara, Bengaluru 560045
offices.evidence: A business directory lists Nvidia at 'C-1 Jacaranda, Wing-A, Manyata Embassy Business Park, Outer Ring Road, Bangalore 560045' (https://www.onestopsap.com/companies/nvidia-corporation); OSM office POI 'Nvidia' (node/4834590323) sits on the Silver Oak block; the block name therefore differs between sources.

offices.label: Bagmane Constellation - Orion
offices.address: Orion, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, Doddanekundi, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: Bagmane's Constellation page shows Nvidia (with Boeing) as the occupier of the Orion building (https://www.bagmanegroup.com/portfolio/bagmane-constellation-business-park); developer page only.

offices.label: Bagmane WTC - Goldstone
offices.address: Goldstone, Bagmane World Technology Center, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: Bagmane's WTC page lists Nvidia with Samsung as Goldstone occupiers (https://www.bagmanegroup.com/portfolio/world-technology-centre); developer page only.

offices.label: Bagmane Capital - Memphis South Tower (pre-let)
offices.address: Memphis South Tower, Bagmane Capital, Outer Ring Road, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: Yahoo Finance (Apr 2026) reports a 10-year lease of about 760,000 sq ft across 12 floors of Bagmane Capital's Memphis South Tower in Mahadevpura, effective 1 Apr 2026 (https://finance.yahoo.com/sectors/technology/articles/nvidia-expands-india-ai-demand-123817341.html); OSM POI 'NVidia' node/13781586365 sits on the 'Memphis South (u/c)' footprint, so occupation is not yet verified.

companies.name: AMD
companies.description: US CPU/GPU designer; its Bengaluru 'Technostar' campus, opened Nov 2023, is AMD's largest design centre anywhere (500,000 sq ft, ~3,000 engineers), alongside the older EPIP Whitefield site it has used since 2004.

offices.label: AMD Technostar campus (largest global design centre)
offices.locality: Doddanekundi Industrial Area / Brookefield (ITPL Main Road)
offices.address: Prestige Technostar, Doddanekundi Industrial Area 2, Brookefield, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: AMD's press release (27 Nov 2023) announces its largest global design centre in Bengaluru, 500,000 sq ft for about 3,000 engineers (https://www.amd.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2023-11-27-amd-inaugurates-its-largest-global-design-center-in-india.html); Telecom Review Asia names it the 'AMD Technostar campus' (https://www.telecomreviewasia.com/news/service-news/3786-amd-inaugurates-largest-global-design-center-in-bengaluru-india/); OSM POI 'AMD' node/9811266170 sits inside the Prestige Technostar polygon.

offices.label: EPIP Whitefield campus (Plot 102-103)
offices.address: Plot 102 & 103, EPIP Zone, Whitefield, Bengaluru 560066
offices.evidence: OSM office POI 'AMD' with address '102-103, EPIP Zone, 560066' (node/1821738998); a corporate-registry listing gives AMD India Pvt Ltd's registered address as Plot No. 102 & 103, Export Promotion Industrial Park, Bangalore 560066 (https://www.InstaFinancials.com/company/amd-india-private-limited/U72200KA1997PTC094389).

companies.name: Arm
companies.description: UK CPU-architecture licensor; Bengaluru is Arm's third-largest office worldwide, headquartered in Taurus 4 at Bagmane Constellation with a second site about 1 km away in Bagmane WTC.

offices.label: Bengaluru HQ - Taurus 4, North Tower, Bagmane Constellation
offices.address: Taurus 4 Building, North Tower, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, Doddanekkundi Village, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: Arm's offices page lists 'Bagmane Constellation Business Park, Taurus 4 Building, North Tower, Doddanekkundi Village, Krishnarajapuram Hobli, Bengaluru 560048' (https://www.arm.com/company/offices); Arm's careers page says the site is 'Arm's third-largest global office' occupying ground to 11th floor (https://careers.arm.com/bangalore-office); Bagmane lists ARM at Capital/Constellation.

offices.label: Bagmane WTC - Citrine (5th-6th floor)
offices.address: Citrine Block, Bagmane World Technology Center SEZ, Outer Ring Road, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: Bagmane's WTC page lists ARM as a Citrine occupier (https://www.bagmanegroup.com/portfolio/world-technology-centre); OSM POI 'ARM Embedded Technologies Private Ltd., Outer Ring Road, 560048' (node/9781379833) sits on Citrine; Arm's careers page mentions 'a smaller location about 1km away' from the main office.

offices.label: Bagmane Capital (developer-listed, tower unknown)
offices.address: Bagmane Capital, Outer Ring Road, Doddanekundi, Bengaluru 560048
offices.evidence: Bagmane's Capital page carries the ARM logo among occupiers (https://www.bagmanegroup.com/portfolio/bagmane-capital); no tower given and not corroborated elsewhere.

companies.name: Texas Instruments
companies.description: US analog and embedded chipmaker; TI India (est. 1985) was the first MNC R&D centre in Bengaluru and remains headquartered in Bagmane Tech Park, with an expansion block in Bagmane Cosmos.

offices.label: TI India head office - Lakeview, Bagmane Tech Park (No. 66/3)
offices.address: No. 66/3, Bagmane Tech Park, Adjacent to LRDE, Byrasandra, C.V. Raman Nagar Post, Bengaluru 560093
offices.evidence: TI's contact page lists the Bangalore head office at 'Bagmane Tech Park No. 66/3, Adjacent to LRDE Byrasandra, C V Raman Nagar Post, Bangalore 560093' (https://www.ti.com/contact); Bagmane's Tech Park page lists 'Texas Inst' as a Lakeview occupier (https://www.bagmanegroup.com/portfolio/bagmane-tech-park); OSM POI node/9783665920.

offices.label: Bagmane Cosmos - Ariel block
offices.address: Ariel, Bagmane Cosmos Business Park, Byrasandra, C.V. Raman Nagar, Bengaluru 560093
offices.evidence: Bagmane's Cosmos page lists Texas Instruments as the Ariel block (550,000 sq ft) occupier (https://www.bagmanegroup.com/portfolio/bagmane-cosmos); OSM POI 'Texas Instruments' node/13018340593 is on the Ariel footprint.

companies.name: Micron Technology
companies.description: US memory and storage maker; its Bengaluru engineering centre (DRAM/NAND design, SSD firmware) is in Cessna Business Park, with a smaller Ulsoor office listed on job postings.

offices.label: Cessna Business Park engineering centre
offices.address: Cessna Business Park, Kadubeesanahalli Village, Varthur Hobli, Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: Micron's locations page lists 'Micron Technology Operations India LLP, Cessna Business Park, Kadubeesanahalli Village, Varthur Hobli, Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru 560103' (https://www.micron.com/about/locations); OSM POI 'Micron Technology Operations India' node/10792859847.

offices.evidence: Built In Bengaluru job pages list a Micron office at 'The Millennia Tower B, Unit 402, Ulsoor, Bengaluru 560008' and another on Ulsoor Bazar Street (https://builtinbengaluru.in/job/staff-engineer-analog-design/4153499); job-board source only.

companies.name: SanDisk
aliases: SanDisk India Device Design Centre Pvt Ltd
companies.description: Flash-memory company spun back out of Western Digital in Feb 2025; its Bengaluru device-design centre (opened 2006) sits in Prestige Tech Park on the Outer Ring Road.

offices.label: SanDisk India Device Design Centre - Prestige Tech Park

companies.name: Western Digital
companies.description: US hard-drive maker; its Bengaluru engineering office shares the Prestige Tech Park campus it occupied with SanDisk before the Feb 2025 separation.

offices.address: Prestige Tech Park, Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road, Kadubeesanahalli, Bengaluru 560103

companies.name: Seagate Technology

companies.name: NetApp
companies.description: US data-storage and cloud-data company; its own 15-acre Bengaluru campus at Hoodi (opened 2017 as a Global Center of Excellence) is NetApp's largest site outside the US, built for about 3,300 people.

offices.label: NetApp Bangalore Campus - Hoodi

offices.evidence: Built In lists 'NetApp Bangalore Campus, ITPL Main Road, Hoodi, Bengaluru 560048' (https://builtinbengaluru.in/company/netapp/offices); Inc42 reported the 15-acre Whitefield Global Center of Excellence (https://inc42.com/flash-feed/netapp-global-centre-excellence); OSM maps the campus as commercial polygon 'NetApp' (way/259191813).

companies.name: Samsung Electronics
companies.description: Korean electronics group; SRI-B in Bagmane Constellation is Samsung's largest R&D centre outside Korea, with an overflow campus at Bagmane WTC Goldstone and the SSIR semiconductor research office at Bagmane Capital (opened 2024).

companies.name: MediaTek
companies.description: Taiwanese fabless SoC maker; it set up a Bengaluru R&D centre in 2014 and opened its current R&D, sales and marketing office at RMZ Ecoworld in June 2017.

companies.name: Marvell Technology
companies.description: US data-infrastructure chip designer; its Bengaluru design centre occupies Tower D of Global Technology Park on the Outer Ring Road and is the focus of a $250 million India expansion announced in 2025.

coverageNotes: METHOD: the shared WebSearch budget ran out after the first ten queries, so most facts come from direct fetches of company location pages (Arm, Synopsys, Micron, NXP, TI, Lam Research, Rambus, SiFive, Tenstorrent, Arista, Keysight, Ribbon, Extreme Networks, Cisco, MosChip, Ittiam, LTSCT, InCore, Signalchip, Tejas, Sasken), Bagmane's own portfolio pages (Constellation, Capital, Tech Park, WTC, Cosmos, Solarium City), lease reports (The Realty Today, Propnewstime, Yahoo Finance, NAREDCO), press releases (AMD, MediaTek, Embassy REIT, EQ Mag, YourStory) and the OpenStreetMap office/landuse extracts, cross-checked against the Bagmane/Manyata/ETV/OMR geography lenses already written. COULD NOT CONFIRM (left out, no coordinates could be given without inventing an address): Juniper Networks (now HPE; builtin lists only 'Bengaluru', juniper.net/tofler/zauba blocked), STMicroelectronics (st.com 503 three times), Renesas (every locations URL 404), KLA (site blocks fetches; India presence is mainly Chennai), ASML India (locations page lists no India office), Tokyo Electron, Ampere Computing (403), Cirrus Logic (403), Silicon Labs (403; its India site is Hyderabad), Ciena (403; its India HQ is Gurugram), onsemi (locations page names a 'Bangalore Design Center' but gives only a Google Maps link), Sankalp Semiconductor (HCL-owned, Hubli HQ; sankalpsemi.com 503), Lenovo India (404), Synaptics, MaxLinear, Astera Labs, Mavenir, CommScope and Hitachi Vantara (all 404). Saankhya Labs is folded into Tejas Networks' aliases because it was merged in 2022-23 and no separate office could be sourced; Alphawave Semi is an alias of Qualcomm (awavesemi.com now redirects to qualcomm.com). Mindgrove is Chennai-only and omitted. DELIBERATELY OMITTED: Synopsys' former RMZ Infinity office (not on its current office list after the 2024 Troy lease; no proof of closure), Samsung's old Bagmane Lakeview Block B SISO site (directory-only, likely historical), a second Infineon OSM POI near MG Road and a third Analog Devices POI on Old Madras Road (single OSM nodes with nothing to corroborate). LOW-CONFIDENCE ENTRIES ARE MARKED: Intel's ITPL Main Road POI, Qualcomm Carina West, Arm at Bagmane Capital, Micron Ulsoor, Broadcom Electronics City (phase centroid), ADI RMZ Infinity, Siemens EDA (OSM-only), NI Softzone (OSM-only), Cisco Pritech Park (ex-NDS), Extreme Networks at Bagmane WTC. Nvidia's Memphis South tower is status 'planned' because the lease began 1 Apr 2026 while OSM still marks the tower under construction. Extreme Networks' 'Campus 3B' is assigned to RMZ Ecospace by block naming only; its page does not name the park. Several entries reuse records verified by the Bagmane (G05/G06), Manyata (G01), ETV (G02), OMR (G18), Electronics City (G09) and E01/E02 lenses, with the same URLs. Headcounts are given only where a source states one (NetApp ~2,000, ADI ~600); Bengaluru headcounts for Intel, Qualcomm, Samsung etc. were not re-sourced and are left null.
